In Islamic tradition, this name signifies a person who encourages righteousness and moral values. The etymology of this name can be traced back to the Arabic word 'hathila,' which means to incite or urge towards something. This name is not directly mentioned in the Quran but aligns with the values of promoting good and righteousness as encouraged in several Quranic verses.
